title: Democratizing Football Talent Discovery
subtitle: AI Scout is revolutionizing how football talent is discovered and developed, creating equal opportunities for all players regardless of their background or location.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: To create a world where every talented young footballer has an equal opportunity to be discovered, evaluated, and developed, regardless of their economic background, geographic location, or social connections.

equalAccess.title: Equal Access for All
equalAccess.description: Providing opportunities for talented young players from low-income families who might otherwise be overlooked.

transparent.title: Transparent & Objective
transparent.description: Our AI eliminates human bias and corruption, ensuring fair evaluation based purely on performance data.

global.title: Global Talent Discovery
global.description: Connecting talented players from around the world with scouts and academies, breaking geographical barriers.

aiAnalysis.title: AI-Powered Analysis
aiAnalysis.description: Advanced machine learning algorithms analyze player performance across multiple dimensions including speed, stamina, ball control, tactical vision, and teamwork.

community.title: Community-Driven Platform
community.description: Built for players, coaches, and academies to collaborate and grow together in a supportive ecosystem.

feedback.title: Instant Feedback & Tips
feedback.description: Personalized training recommendations generated in real-time based on individual performance analysis.

vision.title: Long-term Vision
vision.content: We envision a future where national teams and professional clubs discover their next superstars through AI Scout, creating a truly meritocratic system in football.

2026.title: 2026 Goal
2026.content: Partnership with FIFA and UEFA for talent identification

2027.title: 2027 Goal
2027.content: First AI Scout discovery to play in a World Cup
